name: Be a Lucky Block For Squishy Dumplings
desc:
Welcome to Be a Lucky Block For Squishy Dumplings!

❓ Wait for the Dumplings to roll the Lucky Block…

🏃 When it rolls, RUN.
Get back to your base before they catch you.

💸 Collect rewards to earn cash and upgrade your chances of survival.

💤 Your progress continues… even when you’re not in the factory.

💰 Premium players receive +10% extra cash.
